records.title: Programa de patrocinios del Banco de la República para estudios de posgrado en el exterior

validation.notes: The award is the Banco de la Republica's own sponsorship programme, and the record's official page (https://www.banrep.gov.co/es/contenidos/programas-estudios-el-exterior, page title 'Programas de estudios en el exterior | Banco de la Republica') uses this file as its institutional header mark; asset is served from the origin domain www.banrep.gov.co, not from the CloudFront mirror. Verified visually: Banco de la Republica | Colombia lockup with the Mariana emblem and the strapline 'Somos el banco central de Colombia'. Identity independently proven by the Bank's own Manual de Identidad Visual page (fetched): 'La figura central del logo del Banco de la Republica es la efigie de una mujer de perfil, mirando a la derecha', with image alt 'Logo del Banco de la Republica - Colombia, compuesto por la efigie de la Mariana Francesa mirando a la derecha.' Asset verified by GET: HTTP 200, image/png, 550x71, 9866 bytes. Access note: plain fetches of banrep.gov.co return a Radware Bot Manager hCaptcha interstitial; the pages were read with a real browser engine (HTTP 200) and the asset itself fetches normally from the origin domain.

records.title: Zhejiang University "Belt and Road" International School of Medicine Scholarship (PhD)

validation.notes: The official scholarship page on iczu.zju.edu.cn ('Scholarship of International School of Medicine') renders the International Admissions of Zhejiang University site logo in its header: . Verified visually: Zhejiang University emblem with the wordmark 'Zhejiang University / International Admissions' - correct identity for a Zhejiang University award. Asset verified by GET: HTTP 200, image/png, 391x76 (IHDR), 13892 bytes - well above favicon size. Confidence MEDIUM for two honest reasons: (a) this is the publisher's university-level lockup, not an International School of Medicine-specific mark; (b) ZJU-ISM's own site logo (ism.zju.edu.cn/_upload/tpl/0c/f6/3318/template3318/images/2/logo.png and logo-1.png) is a white-on-transparent file whose every opaque pixel is pure white (1924/1924 sampled), so it renders blank and is unusable as an image asset; (c) ism.zju.edu.cn/MediaResources/list.htm publishes no downloadable brand asset, and www.zju.edu.cn/english/ exposes no logo file in its served markup.
